about: Known defects at a known commit. `expect` lists what a good review must find (file, line in the head version, minimum severity); an empty `expect` is a clean case where any should-fix finding counts as a false alarm. Add a case whenever the weekly report names an escaped bug. Run: node scripts/review/eval/eval.ts --max-total-usd 15

expect.what: validate_group_by runs inside parse_reconcile_config, so one bad group_by fails the whole file and the Reconciliation dimension goes absent instead of red
